title: Launcher registration aborts at 8 s before the host's held-claims answer, losing the initial confirmation and native wait on the first run of a fresh named root
outcome: Launcher registration aborts at 8 s before the host's held-claims answer, losing host credit on the first run of a fresh named root
acceptance: scripts/test-run-registration.mjs gives the registration POST/ACK/GET a budget derived from the host's Engram operation budget (as TermAl's launcher does: 2 * engramOperationBudgetMs + 3000), so a host's typed answer after an off-lock held-claims read is received instead of a client abort

A launcher fixture shows a late host answer surfaces the host's definitive response (e.g. 409) rather than a client-side abort, using an injected or configurable budget/delay, with no real multi-second wait in the test
